objective: Describe how light and sound behave and identify safe ways to protect people.

items.explanation: When light bends through raindrops, it spreads into colors, and you see a rainbow. Shadows, echoes, and flashes are not from bending light.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use sound?

options.text: move away if a sound hurts your ears

items.explanation: If a sound hurts your ears, it is too loud — moving away keeps your hearing safe.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use light?

options.text: count the books on a shelf
do not point a laser at your eyes
name a color in the room

items.explanation: A laser is very bright and can damage your eyes, so never point one at anyone's eyes.

items.prompt: Which example shows how sound behaves?

options.text: a rainbow appears when light bends

items.explanation: A bark is a sound the dog makes, and it travels to your ears. Rainbows, mirrors, and windows are about light.

items.prompt: Which example shows how light behaves?

options.text: a rainbow appears when light bends

items.explanation: When light bends through raindrops, it makes a rainbow. Barks, bells, and claps make sound.
